_readme: Model catalog. Architecture fields drive KV-cache sizing; api_prices are USD per 1M tokens. self_hostable=false models appear only in the API comparison. Rows with a "feed" block are refreshed daily by scripts/update_prices.py (GitHub Actions); see data/price-status.json for the latest check. Closed models carry a tier (budget / mid / frontier) from each vendor's own product positioning (small/fast, mid-size, flagship); it only filters the closed-model reference line.

models.name: Kimi K3 (MoE, MLA + linear attention)

kv_layout.source: Hugging Face config.json (moonshotai/Kimi-K3): kv_lora_rank 512 + qk_rope_head_dim 64; linear_attn_config lists 24 full-attention layers, the other 69 are KDA linear-attention layers with a fixed-size state

models.native_precision: MXFP4 MoE weights (~4.25 bits); INT4 is the closest setting here
models.note: Hybrid attention: only the 24 full-attention (MLA) layers keep a KV cache that grows with context; the 69 linear-attention layers keep a small fixed state per request, not modeled. Kimi K3 License (open weights).
